bull_bear.body:
- Reduced governance/disclosure oversight as an SME (NSE Emerge) listed entity — Since the Company's equity share capital is listed exclusively on the NSE Emerge Platform, Corporate Governance Report and Business Responsibility Report requirements are not applicable to the Company, meaning it is exempted from the fuller governance and ESG disclosure regime that applies to main-board listed peers (MD&A section).
- Key managerial personnel (Company Secretary) turnover during the year — The Company Secretary, Ms. Neelam Gattani, resigned on 13 January 2026 and was replaced by Mr. Nabil Ansari, appointed on 16 January 2026, indicating a short KMP transition gap during the year (Board's Report / Secretarial Audit Report).

business.body: Sunrest Lifescience Limited is engaged in the trading business of pharmaceutical products on a wholesale basis. The Company derives operational synergies from its subsidiary, Hetvi Lifesciences Private Limited, which has further strengthened its business capabilities and enhanced its presence across key segments of the pharmaceutical industry.

- Strengthening business fundamentals, enhancing operational efficiencies and expanding market presence (Chairman's Message)
- Deriving operational synergies from subsidiary Hetvi Lifesciences Private Limited to strengthen business capabilities and presence across key pharmaceutical segments (Chairman's Message)
- Focus on operational excellence, process optimisation, customer satisfaction and sustainable business practices (Chairman's Message)

sk.overview: The DRHP's commissioned industry chapter (Frost & Sullivan, "Independent Market Research on the Overview of the Global API Market and Fermentation Technologies", August 2026) frames the issuer inside the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) industry, and within it the fermentation-derived API segment and its corticosteroid and steroid-hormone sub-segments, extending into specialty injectables (double-chamber drug-device combinations) and CDMO services. The API is described as the primary therapeutic component of a drug; global API demand is said to be rising with pharmaceutical consumption, …

sk.structure: Global API supply is fragmented in count but concentrated in capability: more than 3,000 API manufacturers exist worldwide but only about 20% can meet cGMP requirements, and these are concentrated in the US, Europe, Japan, China and India; the qualified set narrows further for fermentation APIs. …
